### Letting God Read Your Letters
Author: Jill Briscoe
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/one-year-devotions-for-women/letting-god-read-your-letters-one-year-devotions-for-women-february-19.html
Passage: 2 Kings 19:14
Points:
- Threatening circumstances can easily paralyze us with fear.
- Hezekiah modeled bringing terrifying news straight to God rather than panicking.
- In prayer, Hezekiah anchored himself by remembering the Lord's supreme power and majesty.
- Believers can lay out the distressing facts of life before God in their quiet time.
- Entrusting our fears to God in prayer produces unparalleled peace of mind.

### Make Your Requests Known to God
Author: Glenna Marshall
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-august-10-2026.html
Passage: 2 Kings 19:14
Points:
- Severe physical or emotional pain can leave us unsure of how to pray.
- Instead of frantically contriving human plans, Hezekiah laid out his crisis before the Lord.
- Hezekiah prayed with confidence in God's sovereign power to intervene.
- Through Christ's sacrifice, believers have direct access to bring any suffering before the Father.
- Laying our pain before God assures us of His presence and commitment to our good.
